rules: within0.25mm of retained input global axis bounds
own Raw distance>1mm AND native Mask boundary<=2px
candidate_generation.sort: previous9, source_axis_extrema, global_boundary, depth_jump, raw_edge; native_pixel_ID ascending within priority
candidate_generation.unreviewed_anomalies: listed in full discovery CSV; never removed
candidate_generation.threshold_basis: reuse0.25mm support, D0 raw1mm diagnostic; jump4x0.25; bounded candidate-only flags, never deletion criteria

projection.r14: positive/unknown observations only, never negative voter
projection.archived_depth_sampling: exact original archival depth pack, as Gate A; native baseline validity must also hold; either native or archived near depth is a conservative support veto
projection.categories: D near support -> retain; B any eligible Polyp layer competition -> retain; A >=2 distinct block silhouette contradictions and no support/layer competition -> derived exclude; C otherwise retain Unknown
projection.legal_negative: inside real RGB, positive axial Z, BG>8px outside Polyp, no Ring CAD first-hit occlusion, no Ring Mask, inherited conditional camera, no known visibility/order conflict
projection.camera_truth: same inherited conditional usage; pilot INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE preserved; engineering proxy, not physicalGT
projection.occlusion: CAD/Ring/field/boundary/invalid-depth/known layer occlusion never negative votes; unknown true background geometry remains a limitation
projection.same_block: ref08 and r04=B3 count once; RGB correlation not statistical independence
projection.protected_CORE: CORE native interior>2px AND own original Raw distance<=1mm retained even if silhouette votes disagree; signal camera/visibility ambiguity instead
projection.r14_near: uncertified positive near-depth vetoes removal but does not certify support

domain.rule: make_domain, all retained XYZ + unchanged CAD, margin=max(2mm,10% maximum span), cube round up0.001mm

crop.thin_alternative: diagnostic proposal only, cannot change frozen gate

resampling.extremes: top1 maximum per source, all three downsampled sources; fixed original identities
resampling.method: diagnose forward original-to-output pairing separately from actual inverse NN sampling
resampling.candidate_revision: proposal only; no interpolation, no automatic extra filtering
